text:
marco: Heads up — scheduling an incremental feature-flag ramp for `llm-route-v4` tomorrow 00:30 UTC in the midnight safety window. Plan: 0→1% → 5% → 20% over ~30m. Scheduler will nudge cohorts every 5m. Pin model version to v4.2 for canary. Requesting rollout ACKs.

deploybot: Scheduled ramp created: runbook uid r-1707520000. Steps: create cohorts, apply % changes via `ffctl`. Will post snapshots during ramp. :robot_face:

elaine: ACK. What's the rollback trigger? latency P95 > 250ms or error rate > 0.5%? Do we want a lagging step if we see latency rise?

jordan: +1 on those thresholds. Also add embedding-quality regression check (eval delta > 3%) — if eval score delta > 3% fail.

sre-bot: Monitoring hooks attached: dashboards/llm-route-v4 and alerts: `llm-route-latency-p95`, `llm-route-err-rate`. Alert esc to #eng-oncall if triggered. Link: https://internal.metrics/r/llm-route-v4

marco: Good. Add two extra guardrails: (1) auto-mute if CPU on dedicated pool > 85% for 3m (2) version pin fallback to v3.9 if model load errors observed. ops pls confirm artifacts pinned.

ops: Confirmed — image tag `redwood/llm-route:v4.2-pin-170752` pushed to gcr and pinned in rollout config. Also added `canary-only` semantic in ff config.

deploybot: To ops / infra: running staged toggles now in dry-run mode. Command used:
```
ffctl apply --flag=llm-route-v4 --from=0 --to=1 --step=1m --cohorts=10 --pin-version=v4.2 --dry-run
```
Dry-run shows no conflicts. Will remove `--dry-run` at 00:30 UTC if no objections.

elaine: leave dry-run for an extra 5m post-00:30? I'm leaning no — but ok with immediate if everyone watches.

jordan: I'll have a quick watch rotation for first 15m. tagging @oncall_pager

marco: If any alert fires, we roll back to v3.9 and set flag to 0%. Manual rollback steps in r-1707520000 runbook. Also adding note to release notes: 'Canary pinned to v4.2; incremental roll started 00:30 UTC. Rollback criteria and autosuppress present.'

deploybot: Noted. Final go/no-go at 00:28 UTC. Send thumbs in channel to proceed. :thumbsup:

elaine: 👍

jordan: 👍

ops: 👍

marco: proceeding to schedule. Thanks everyone.
